paragraphs: Springshare sells cloud software built for libraries, spanning subject guides, websites, calendars, room booking, virtual reference, forms and data analysis. The product list on the homepage includes LibGuides for content management, LibCal for event calendars and room reservations, LibAnswers for chat and FAQs, LibStaffer for staff scheduling and LibInsight for data collection.

Buyers named on these pages are libraries and educational institutions, with the company page claiming 8,000+ institutions served in 100+ countries. Product copy on the homepage names public libraries as the setting for its patron engagement and marketing automation software. Four customer quotations on the homepage come from Queens University of Charlotte, Western Washington University, Georgia State University and State College of Florida.

Springshare also runs a chat cooperative staffed by librarians, which the homepage says assists hundreds of libraries with round-the-clock online chat coverage. The company page dates the founding to 2007 and describes the business as a cloud software vendor for libraries.

quote.text: Our mission is to help libraries provide great service to users and enhance their online services.
